description: With a negative AGI the § 170(p) deduction is $0 (60% of a contribution base below zero allows nothing), which matters for Form 6251 line 1b. TY2026 single: wages $90,000, Schedule C loss $100,000 → AGI −$10,000; cash gifts $1,500; ISO spread $300,000. Line 1b −$10,000 − $16,100 = −$26,100; line 2a +$16,100; line 2i +$300,000 → AMTI $290,000. Exemption $90,100 → line 6 $199,900 × 26% = $51,974; regular tax $0 → AMT $51,974. (Allowing $1,000 under § 170(p) gave AMTI $289,000.)
